INSERT INTO container_info ( node_ip, container_id, container_name, image, state, status, created_at, last_seen_time, ports_json, extra_json, is_deleted ) VALUES
( #{item.nodeIp}, #{item.containerId}, #{item.containerName}, #{item.image}, #{item.state}, #{item.status}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.lastSeenTime}, #{item.portsJson, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{item.extraJson, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{item.isDeleted} )
ON CONFLICT (node_ip, container_id) DO UPDATE SET container_name = EXCLUDED.container_name, image = EXCLUDED.image, state = EXCLUDED.state, status = EXCLUDED.status, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, last_seen_time = EXCLUDED.last_seen_time, ports_json = EXCLUDED.ports_json, extra_json = EXCLUDED.extra_json, is_deleted = false
